# AVR, checked against avr-elf-as -mmcu=avr51 (GNU binutils 2.47): the forms
# the default core in avr.txt does not have, which an ATmega128 does — jmp and
# call, movw, the multiplies, elpm, spm and break — and rjmp and rcall, which no
# longer wrap at 8K. One statement per line.

# ---- program memory load ---------------------------------------------------
lpm r0, Z+
lpm r0, z+
lpm r5, Z+
lpm r5, z+
lpm r16, Z+
lpm r16, z+
lpm r31, Z+
lpm r31, z+
elpm
elpm r0, Z
elpm r0, Z+
elpm r0, z
elpm r0, z+
elpm r5, Z
elpm r5, Z+
elpm r5, z
elpm r5, z+
elpm r16, Z
elpm r16, Z+
elpm r16, z
elpm r16, z+
elpm r31, Z
elpm r31, Z+
elpm r31, z
elpm r31, z+

# ---- no operands -----------------------------------------------------------
break

# ---- self-programming ------------------------------------------------------
spm
spm Z
spm Z+
spm z
spm z+

# ---- two registers ---------------------------------------------------------
mul r0, r5
mul r1, r5
mul r7, r5
mul r15, r5
mul r16, r5
mul r17, r5
mul r23, r5
mul r24, r5
mul r25, r5
mul r26, r5
mul r29, r5
mul r30, r5
mul r31, r5
mul r5, r0
mul r5, r1
mul r5, r7
mul r5, r15
mul r5, r16
mul r5, r17
mul r5, r23
mul r5, r24
mul r5, r25
mul r5, r26
mul r5, r29
mul r5, r30
mul r5, r31
mul r31,r31
mul R16, R17
mul 3, 4
mul xl, zh

# ---- absolute jump and call ------------------------------------------------
call 0
call 2
call 0x1234
call 0x10000
call 0x3ffffe
call 0x123456
jmp 0
jmp 2
jmp 0x1234
jmp 0x10000
jmp 0x3ffffe
jmp 0x123456

# ---- movw ------------------------------------------------------------------
movw r0, r0
movw r0, r30
movw r0, x
movw r2, r0
movw r2, r30
movw r2, x
movw r14, r0
movw r14, r30
movw r14, x
movw r16, r0
movw r16, r30
movw r16, x
movw r24, r0
movw r24, r30
movw r24, x
movw r30, r0
movw r30, r30
movw r30, x
movw x, r0
movw x, r30
movw x, x
movw y, r0
movw y, r30
movw y, x
movw z, r0
movw z, r30
movw z, x

# ---- multiplies ------------------------------------------------------------
muls r16, r16
muls r16, r31
muls r17, r16
muls r17, r31
muls r24, r16
muls r24, r31
muls r31, r16
muls r31, r31
mulsu r16, r16
mulsu r16, r19
mulsu r16, r23
mulsu r19, r16
mulsu r19, r19
mulsu r19, r23
mulsu r23, r16
mulsu r23, r19
mulsu r23, r23
fmul r16, r16
fmul r16, r19
fmul r16, r23
fmul r19, r16
fmul r19, r19
fmul r19, r23
fmul r23, r16
fmul r23, r19
fmul r23, r23
fmuls r16, r16
fmuls r16, r19
fmuls r16, r23
fmuls r19, r16
fmuls r19, r19
fmuls r19, r23
fmuls r23, r16
fmuls r23, r19
fmuls r23, r23
fmulsu r16, r16
fmulsu r16, r19
fmulsu r16, r23
fmulsu r19, r16
fmulsu r19, r19
fmulsu r19, r23
fmulsu r23, r16
fmulsu r23, r19
fmulsu r23, r23
